description: Invented lines spoken by a character. First two lines per emotion are development; final two held out. Labels are engineering expectations, not independent human emotion ratings.

neutral: The appointment is at three o'clock.
I saved the file in the documents folder.
The train leaves from platform four.
There are two items remaining on the list.
happy: Yes! It worked! I am so pleased with how that turned out!
That is wonderful news; you have made my day.
I am delighted we finally got it working!
Oh, that makes me genuinely glad. What a lovely surprise.
curious: How does that little mechanism work? I want to understand it.
What made you choose that approach? I am interested.
I wonder what happens if we change that setting. Can we find out?
Tell me more about how you built it; I want to know.
smug: I did tell you that would work. Being right suits me.
Of course my solution was the best one. Obviously.
You can admit it: I called that perfectly.
Another flawless prediction from me. Try to contain your admiration.
annoyed: Stop asking the same thing. I am losing patience with you.
That is the third interruption. It is getting irritating.
Oh, for goodness' sake, listen to what I just said.
You ignored the answer again. I am fed up with repeating it.
bored: This is dull. I have completely lost interest.
I cannot bring myself to care about another identical spreadsheet.
Nothing interesting is happening. This is tedious.
Another hour of the same thing. I am bored out of my mind.
sleepy: I can barely keep my eyes open. I need to sleep.
I keep yawning and nodding off. Bed sounds good.
I am so drowsy that I might fall asleep sitting here.
Let me curl up and have a nap; I am struggling to stay awake.
surprised: Wait, what? I did not see that coming!
Whoa! That happened out of nowhere!
You finished already? I was not expecting that at all!
What on earth was that? It caught me completely off guard!
affectionate: I missed having you around. I like being here with you.
You matter to me more than I usually let on.
I am fond of you, you know. Your company means a lot.
Come sit with me for a bit. I like our quiet moments together.
embarrassed: You heard me say that? Oh no, I want to hide.
I cannot believe I said that out loud. Please stop looking at me.
My face is burning. Can we pretend that never happened?
Oh, that was awkward. I have thoroughly embarrassed myself.
determined: I am not giving up. I will keep working until this is done.
Right. I am going to tackle this and see it through.
Setbacks or not, I am committed to finishing what I started.
We have a hard task ahead, and I am ready to put in the work.
worried: I am concerned about you. Please let me know you got home safely.
I cannot stop worrying that something might have gone wrong.
I feel uneasy about how this is going. I hope you are okay.
You have been gone much longer than expected, and I am getting anxious.

reported_emotions: The report says the character was annoyed in the previous scene.
The game has a status effect named sleepy.
You said you were bored yesterday; I wrote that down.
The dialogue label on this line is happy.
The database contains a field called stress.
The actor described the role as a worried parent.
